verdict.rationale: Twenty's workflow engine can chain a 'Send email' step with Delay, Branch and Iterator steps. Workflows can be triggered manually, on record changes or on schedules, so an ops user could build a multi-step email sequence inside the CRM. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated sequences or templated-email feature; this is a do-it-yourself workflow build rather than a purpose-built outreach tool. Missing for 10: email templates with merge fields, a native sequence/cadence feature (enrollment, stop-on-reply), per-prospect send tracking, and hands-on corroboration.
